boundaries: One original phase/read index is accounted for once; no missing fields, identities, names, source bodies or synthetic GET responses are supplied
Owner, peer and foreign reader scopes use only explicitly exported actor IDs, never the owner's ID as another actor
If peer ID is absent, its experience responses use the real shared parser without an identity scope and its products use original metadata checks only; these are not scoped project-reader passes
If foreign ID is absent, original 403s are checked at their original transport boundary only, not counted as foreign scoped-reader calls
The experience DTO does not echo category/product/principal; route scope and actual backend ACL remain authoritative
Category scope is truly product_id null; a positive original product_revision is retained and no first model is selected
Each project/candidate/rule and each configuration kind returns at most 100 rows; returned counts are not global totals or completeness claims
Fixed history is version metadata, not historical body content; current candidates/configurations never rewrite older rule bindings
Original as_of, applicability, nature, can_revise, history, authorship and server usability are preserved, with no local clock inference
The standalone source status mutation is the precise negative PG fixture, not a user-facing withdrawal operation
Pure React SSR uses actual original DTOs and exported display components; names come only from exact original metadata and no personnel names are invented
No browser, interaction, theme, responsive, qualification, actual external send or production validation is performed

actor_scope_coverage.principal_ids_source: isolated fixture request contexts; not GET response echoes
actor_scope_coverage.missing_identity_behavior: No owner substitution; shared parser/original transport only, not a scoped UI reader verification
